'''Nho'Apakk''' was an [[Ewok/Legends|Ewok]] [[Soldier/Legends|warrior]] from [[Bright Tree Village/Legends|Bright Tree Village]] on the [[Endor/Legends|Forest Moon of Endor]]. During the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]] in [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]], [[Gender/Legends|he]] helped [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] forces defeat [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]]. Nho'Apakk had [[Color/Legends|off-white]] fur and wore a greenish hood. The Ewok fought with a three-pronged, wooden [[Staff/Legends|staff]].

==Biography==
Nho'Apakk was a [[Gender/Legends|male]]<ref name="HQA" /> [[Ewok/Legends|Ewok]] of [[Bright Tree Village/Legends|Bright Tree Village]]<ref name="EGC 184" /> who served his tribe as a [[Soldier/Legends|warrior]] on the [[Endor/Legends|Forest Moon of Endor]].<ref name="TLC" /> In [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]],<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> a small [[Endor strike team/Legends|group]] of [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] [[operative]]s arrived on Endor and convinced Nho'Apakk's [[City/Legends|village]] that the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], which had established a presence on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] to support the construction of a new [[Death Star II/Legends|Death Star]] [[Battle station/Legends|battle station]] in the [[Endor system/Legends|system]], was a threat the Ewoks could help defeat.<ref name="ROTJ">{{Film|VI}}.</ref> Nho'Apakk thus joined with his fellow Ewoks in the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]] to fight alongside the Rebel forces, and the warrior personally attacked [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]] sent by the Empire.<ref name="TLC" />

==Personality and traits==
Nho'Apakk had cream-[[Color/Legends|colored]] fur, a brown nose, pale fingers and toes, and black [[Eye/Legends|eyes]]. The Ewok preferred to avoid confrontation whenever possible, but he was willing to defend Bright Tree Village fearsomely if need be. The warrior wore a brown-green hood. He fought with a wooden [[Staff/Legends|staff]] with three prongs at its tip.<ref name="TLC" />

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|We promised him that we'd get together and celebrate as soon as we got our final samples at the start of production so he can have the first one. It's a small story in the grand scheme of things, but it made a *huge*impact on Noah and his family, and we can't thank Lucasfilm enough for helping to make one little boy's life, and Star Wars experience, magical and something we'll all never forget.|Hasbro|<ref name="HQA" />}}
[[File:MaybeNhoApakk-FF109.png|180px|thumb|An unnamed Ewok, similar to Nho'Apakk with a spear similar to his action figure's]]
The Nho'Apakk action figure, part of [[Hasbro]]'s ''[[Star Wars: The Legacy Collection]]'' toy line, is based on an Ewok costume seen in the film [[Star Wars: Episode VI Return of the Jedi|''Star Wars'': Episode VI ''Return of the Jedi'']].<ref name="HQA" /><ref name="ROTJ" /> Lucasfilm's [[Leland Chee]] once speculated an Ewok in a ''Return of the Jedi'' publicity photograph holding a film slate may be Nho'Apakk,<ref name="LChee">{{Facebook|noprofile=1|url=permalink.php?story_fbid=499391386749353&id=201820953172172|name=Leland Chee|date=November 22, 2012|nobackup=1}}</ref><ref name="EW">{{WebCite|url=http://ew.com/gallery/return-jedi-5-unseen-pics-revealed|text="'Return of the Jedi': 5 Unseen Pics Revealed!"|author=Boucher, Geoff|date=2013-05-08|work=Entertainment Weekly|archivedate=20180726082608}}</ref> but that Ewok is actually [[Stemzee]]. [[Yub Yub: Meet the Ewoks from Endor|An article]] on [[StarWars.com]] identified Nho'Apakk as another, hard to spot Ewok in the film.<ref name="Yub Yub">{{SW|url=news/meet-the-ewoks-from-endor|text=Yub Yub: Meet the Ewoks from Endor|int=Yub Yub: Meet the Ewoks from Endor|nolive=1}}</ref> A promotional photo from the movie, reprinted in [[The Official Star Wars Fact File 109|''The Official Star Wars Fact File'' 109]], featured an Ewok with a similar appearance to the one identified on StarWars.com and holding a three-pronged spear like the action figure's. Though no source has officially linked that photo to the name.<ref name="FF109">{{FactFile|109|EWO 9-12|Ewok Warriors}}</ref>

Hasbro released the Ewok action figure in [[2009]] as part of a two-pack with fellow Ewok [[Paploo/Legends|Paploo]]. Nho'Apakk's description on the toy card fails to note whether the Ewok is male or female, but in official statements, Hasbro has identified him as a male.<ref name="HQA" /> The character's portrait illustration on the figure card is a repainted version of the one used for [[Graak]] on Hasbro's [[Romba/Legends|Romba]] and Graak two-pack, released in [[2007]].<ref name="30th">{{HasbroCite|set=Star Wars: 30th Anniversary Collection|pack=#43: Romba & Graak (Ewok Warriors)|altlink=https://www.rebelscum.com/TAC43ewoks.asp}}</ref> As such, the card image does not match the appearance of the actual Nho'Apakk action figure.<ref name="HQA" />

[[File:NhoApakkPaploo-TheLegacyCollection.jpg|thumb|250px|left|The Nho'Apakk action figure (left) was designed after a costume created for ''Return of the Jedi''.]]
Nho'Apakk is named for a ''[[Star Wars]]'' fan named [[Noah]]. In Spring [[2008]], Noah, then seven years old, was facing a debilitating operation from which it would take him several months to recover. The boy lived near Hasbro's headquarters, and, when the toy company heard about his impending surgery, they invited him for a tour and to discuss their ''Star Wars'' toy line. There, Noah revealed that he was a fan of the Ewoks from ''Return of the Jedi.'' Hasbro, incidentally, was in the preliminary design stages for a new pair of Ewok action figures. They showed Noah several production shots of the various Ewoks used in ''Return of the Jedi'' and asked him to choose the two he found most interesting; the boy selected Paploo and a white-furred Ewok that Hasbro staff were largely unfamiliar with. Nevertheless, they honored Noah's wishes and decided to design new action figures of his choices.<ref name="HQA" />

[[File:Nho_Apakk.jpg|thumb|156px|The recolored action figure package art representing Nho'Apakk]]
Production progressed by several months, and the white-furred Ewok remained unidentified. Hasbro and [[Lucasfilm]] then realized that the character was one of several Ewoks who had not yet received official names. Hasbro proposed naming the Ewok for Noah; Lucasfilm agreed and provided the name "Nho'Apakk" to sound like an [[Ewokese/Legends|Ewokese]] version of the boy's first name and parts of his surname. Hasbro promised to give the boy the first Nho'Apakk figure from the toy's production run, and the company claimed that the whole experience strongly affected both Noah and his family. By [[May]] [[2009]], Noah had undergone his operation and was in recovery.<ref name="HQA" />
